Do not copy the human source long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy. Keep the original actual exact primary angle and head roll; do not rotate into a frontal pose to conceal the issue.

Keep full tilted frame, OPAQUE grey photographic backing and complete lower-right cream note overlap. No new neck pendant, hidden medals, facial hair, readable text or watermark. Genuine alpha only outside the entire framed card. All original internal surfaces remain opaque.

All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
